name: fuze
description: MCP server for the FUZE agent: status, the verified signal, the address of the local read-only page (`fuze ui`), and tools that can only reduce risk. Starts the command `fuze`, so it works only when fuze (installed from the repository checkout; not on PyPI yet) is on the PATH Claude Code sees and the agent uses the default folder ~/.fuze. Otherwise use `fuze mcp-config`.
